clauses.clause: {1}, {T}: Choose a card name, then reveal the top card of your library.
If that card has the chosen name, sacrifice this artifact and draw three cards.

mapping.notes: M8 mapper. Refused whole by the compiler's sorcery-gate fault; mapped whole. 'That card' is the revealed top card: comparison over number_in(<zone>) over Zone(LIBRARY, YOU, TOP) with NAME_CHOSEN (Conspicuous Snoop's top-card form). A bare NAME_CHOSEN Conditional would judge the Lockbox itself (executor._conditional_subject), which naming 'Diviner's Lockbox' would satisfy. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/M20/diviners_lockbox_*.json. Ontology round R12: the tree translated into the one comparison (same meaning), the draft, clauses and notes reworded.

clauses.clause: {1}, {T}: Choose a card name, then reveal the top card of your library.
clauses.evidence: [activate [0]]: 'ask name' offers card names, 'card becomes tapped', 'you: mana C-1' (the {1} and the {T} are paid), ABILITY_ACTIVATED. The reveal is information only (tree REVEAL controller YOU count 1, no REVEAL lane in the runner): judged from the tree and trace, and its effect is what the next clause's trace rows show (only the name of the top card, Library 5, matches). F01_2 names the second card of the library: nothing happens and the library is unchanged.

clauses.clause: If that card has the chosen name, sacrifice this artifact and draw three cards.
clauses.evidence: [activate [0] | ask 1 -> Library 5] (the top card): 'card moves battlefield -> graveyard (by card/SACRIFICE)', then three draws (Library 5#1, 4#1, 3#1), 'you: hand 6 -> 9; library 6 -> 3'. [ask 1 -> Library 0..4 / Forest / Lockbox]: only cost, no sacrifice, no draw. Tree: Conditional(QTY_GE 1 over the revealed top card with NAME_CHOSEN) then Seq(SACRIFICE IS_SOURCE, DRAW 3 YOU). F01_1 repeats it with named cards (hand 3, Lockbox in the graveyard).

Tree has timing=ActivationWindow.SORCERY, but the probe activates only in the main phase with an empty stack, so a refusal never shows. F01_3 (own beginning of combat: window:sorcery), F01_4 (Shock waiting on the stack in the own main phase: refused; legal once the stack is empty), F01_5 (opponent's turn: refused).
